sources.retainingWall.sliding: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Chapter 3 sets no factor for retaining walls; IBC 2021 Sec 1807.2.3: 1.5 against sliding and overturning
sources.retainingWall.seismic: IBC 2021 Sec 1807.2.3: 1.1 where the load combinations include earthquake
sources.retainingWall.passive: Practice (NAVFAC DM 7.02 Ch 3): passive resistance divided by 2 for the movement it needs
sources.retainingWall.flotation: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 2.6.5.2 (uplift, p680) sets no factor; 1.1 as the ground tanks (ASCE 7 0.6D + H practice)
sources.retainingWall.baseFriction: NAVFAC DM 7.02 Table 10-1 practice: tan δb with δb = 2/3 φ' for concrete cast on soil
sources.retainingWall.adhesion: NAVFAC DM 7.02 Table 10-1 practice: adhesion about 0.5 cu
sources.retainingWall.yieldingKh: AASHTO LRFD 11.6.5.2.2: kh = 0.5 kh0 for a wall free to move 25-50 mm
sources.strutAndTie: ACI 318-19 Tables 23.4.3, 23.9.2, Secs 23.2.7, 23.5.1 (the procedure BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 6.4.6 sends deep members to; φ in BNBC Sec 6.2.3.2, p. 897); tieArm is SAEngine practice
